name: Sakaki Yuika
source:
Sakaki Yuika is a vampire hunter affiliated with the Hunters' Association.

While she is quiet and taciturn on the outside, her heart burns with hatred toward all vampires. Trained to do battle with creatures far stronger than she is and armed to the teeth, Yuika is ruthless in combat. Her signature weapon is a powerful pile bunker that can easily extinguish a vampire’s life with lethal efficiency. She commands a unit of three biological weapons developed to assist in hunting vampires. While Yuika remains loyal to the Association and will put its orders above her personal goals if need be, the same cannot be said for her subordinates. Keeping them in line is a constant source of concern for her.

[i]"I will exterminate... every single vampire..."[/i]
